-- Studio-side, repeatable landscaping. Called through MCP; never runs on server startup.
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local configCopy = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config:Clone()
configCopy.Parent = SS
local Config = require(configCopy)
configCopy:Destroy()
local E = Config.Environment
local Builder = {}
local function folder(name, parent)
	local f = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not f then f = Instance.new("Folder") f.Name = name f.Parent = parent end
	return f
end
local function environment()
	return folder("Environment", workspace.Greybox)
end
local function bounds(obj)
	local lo, hi
	for _, p in {obj, table.unpack(obj:GetDescendants())} do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, x in {-1, 1} do for _, y in {-1, 1} do for _, z in {-1, 1} do
				local q = p.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(p.Size * Vector3.new(x, y, z) / 2)
				lo = lo and Vector3.new(math.min(lo.X,q.X),math.min(lo.Y,q.Y),math.min(lo.Z,q.Z)) or q
				hi = hi and Vector3.new(math.max(hi.X,q.X),math.max(hi.Y,q.Y),math.max(hi.Z,q.Z)) or q
			end end end
		end
	end
	assert(lo, "Asset has no physical parts")
	return {Center = (lo+hi)/2, Size = hi-lo, Min = lo, Max = hi}
end
local function abs(v) return Vector3.new(math.abs(v.X), math.abs(v.Y), math.abs(v.Z)) end
local function strip(model)
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		for _, tag in CS:GetTags(d) do CS:RemoveTag(d, tag) end
		if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or d:IsA("LayerCollector") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Sound") then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end
end
local function fit(source, name, target, targetSize, reference)
	local ref = reference or bounds(source)
	local scale = targetSize / ref.Size
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	local copy = source:Clone()
	copy.Parent = model
	strip(model)
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local localScale = Vector3.new(abs(p.CFrame.RightVector):Dot(scale), abs(p.CFrame.UpVector):Dot(scale), abs(p.CFrame.LookVector):Dot(scale))
			local position = (p.Position-ref.Center) * scale
			local rotation = p.CFrame.Rotation
			p.Size *= localScale
			p.CFrame = target * CFrame.new(position) * rotation
			p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
			p.CastShadow = false
			for _, mesh in p:GetChildren() do
				if mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") and mesh.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
					mesh.Scale *= localScale
					mesh.Offset *= localScale
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return model
end
local function smallAsset(source, name, position, scale, angle)
	local b = bounds(source)
	local size = b.Size * scale
	return fit(source,name,CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,angle or 0,0),size)
end
local function sign(parent,name,position,size,face,text,color)
	local p=Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name,p.Size,p.Position=name,size,position
	p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanTouch,p.CanQuery=true,false,false,false
	p.Color,p.Material=color,Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Parent=parent
	local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name="SurfaceGui" gui.Face=face gui.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud gui.PixelsPerStud=30 gui.Parent=p
	local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name="Label" label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.94,0.92) label.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.03,0.04)
	label.BackgroundTransparency=1 label.Text=text label.TextScaled=true label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(243,241,210) label.Parent=gui
	return p
end

function Builder.BuildStage(n)
	local sources=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets
	local stage=workspace.Greybox.Hallway.Stages["Stage_"..n]
	local root=folder("Stages",environment())
	local old=root:FindFirstChild("Stage_"..n) if old then old:Destroy() end
	local group=Instance.new("Folder") group.Name="Stage_"..n group.Parent=root
	stage.Material=Enum.Material.Grass stage.Color=E.GrassColor
	local top=stage.Position.Y+stage.Size.Y/2
	local cellX=stage.Size.X/E.GrassColumns
	local halfLength=(stage.Size.Z-E.LabelClearLength)/2
	local cellZ=halfLength/E.GrassRowsPerHalf
	local grass=folder("Grass",group)
	for _, direction in {-1,1} do
		for row=1,E.GrassRowsPerHalf do
			for col=1,E.GrassColumns do
				local x=-stage.Size.X/2+(col-0.5)*cellX
				local z=direction*(E.LabelClearLength/2+(row-0.5)*cellZ)
				local center=stage.Position+Vector3.new(x,stage.Size.Y/2+E.GrassHeight/2-0.04,z)
				local rotation=(n+row+col)%2*math.pi
				local patch=fit(sources["Realistic grass"],"GrassPatch",CFrame.new(center)*CFrame.Angles(0,rotation,0),
					Vector3.new(cellX*E.GrassOverlap,E.GrassHeight,cellZ*E.GrassOverlap))
				patch.Parent=grass
			end
		end
	end
	local count=0 for _,d in grass:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("BasePart") then count+=1 end end
	assert(count<=E.MaxGrassPartsPerStage,"Grass budget exceeded")
	local rng=Random.new(E.Seed+n)
	for _, side in {-1,1} do
		sign(group,"StageSign_"..side,Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2-0.35),top+E.StageSignHeight,stage.Position.Z-stage.Size.Z/2+18),
			E.StageSignSize,side==1 and Enum.NormalId.Left or Enum.NormalId.Right,
			"STAGE "..n.."\n"..Config.StageTier[n],E.StageSignColor)
		for _, fraction in {-0.32,0.32} do
			local position=Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2-E.EdgeInset),top,stage.Position.Z+stage.Size.Z*fraction)
			smallAsset(sources.Bush,"EdgeBush",position,E.BushScale,rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2)).Parent=group
		end
		local bambooPosition=Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2-E.EdgeInset),top,stage.Position.Z+side*stage.Size.Z*0.12)
		smallAsset(sources.Bamboo,"Bamboo",bambooPosition,E.BambooScale,rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2)).Parent=group
		local leafPosition=Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2-E.EdgeInset),top,stage.Position.Z+stage.Size.Z*0.42)
		smallAsset(sources["Bush Leaves Grass"],"BushLeaves",leafPosition,E.BushLeafScale,0).Parent=group
		for i=1,E.TuftsPerStage/2 do
			local position=Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2-E.EdgeInset-2),top,stage.Position.Z+rng:NextNumber(-stage.Size.Z*0.43,stage.Size.Z*0.43))
			smallAsset(sources.Grass,"NaturalTuft",position,E.TuftScale,rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2)).Parent=group
		end
	end
	group:SetAttribute("GrassParts",count)
	return {Stage=n,GrassParts=count}
end

function Builder.BuildWalls()
	local g=workspace.Greybox
	local first,last=g.Hallway.Stages.Stage_1,g.Hallway.Stages["Stage_"..Config.StageCount]
	local startZ,finishZ=first.Position.Z-first.Size.Z/2,last.Position.Z+last.Size.Z/2
	local source=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets.GrassToplingsH1
	local ref=bounds(source)
	local wallFolder=folder("Walls",environment())
	wallFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	for _,side in {-1,1} do
		local x=first.Position.X+side*(first.Size.X/2+E.WallDepth/2+E.WallOutsideOffset)
		local target=CFrame.new(x,first.Position.Y+first.Size.Y/2+E.WallHeight/2,(startZ+finishZ)/2)
		local targetSize=Vector3.new(E.WallDepth,E.WallHeight,finishZ-startZ)
		for _,segment in source:GetChildren() do
			if segment:IsA("Model") then
				local clone=fit(segment,(side==1 and "Right_" or "Left_")..segment.Name,target,targetSize,ref)
				clone.Parent=wallFolder
				task.wait()
			end
		end
		local collider=g.Hallway.Walls[side==1 and "Wall_Right" or "Wall_Left"]
		collider.Transparency=1 collider.CastShadow=false
	end
	return {Length=finishZ-startZ,Segments=#wallFolder:GetChildren()}
end

function Builder.BuildPlot(n)
	local plot=workspace.Greybox.Plots["Plot_"..n]
	local base=plot.Base
	local old=plot:FindFirstChild("Visuals") if old then old:Destroy() end
	local source=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets.Plots["Plot 1"]
	local ref=bounds(source)
	local xSize,zSize=base.Size.X-E.PlotInset*2,base.Size.Z-E.PlotInset*2
	local heightScale=math.min(xSize/ref.Size.X,zSize/ref.Size.Z)
	local size=Vector3.new(xSize,ref.Size.Y*heightScale,zSize)
	local top=base.Position.Y+base.Size.Y/2
	local plaza=workspace.Greybox.Plaza.PlazaFloor
	local side=base.Position.X>plaza.Position.X and 1 or -1
	local rotation=side==1 and math.pi or 0
	local frame=CFrame.new(base.Position.X,top+size.Y/2,base.Position.Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,rotation,0)
	local visual=fit(source,"Visuals",frame,size)
	local count=0
	for _,d in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			count+=1
			-- Floors and structural supports collide; decorative trim and pads do not.
			d.CanCollide=(d.Size.Y<0.65 and math.max(d.Size.X,d.Size.Z)>10)
				or (d.Size.Y>2 and math.min(d.Size.X,d.Size.Z)>0.2 and not d.Name:match("^Slot"))
			d.CastShadow=d.CanCollide
		end
	end
	assert(count<=E.MaxPlotVisualParts,"Plot budget exceeded")
	local padCount=0
	for i=1,Config.SlotsPerPlot do
		local pad
		for _,p in visual:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name=="Slot"..i and p.Position.Y<top+1.5 and p.Size.Y>0.06 and p.Size.Y<0.13 then
				pad=p break
			end
		end
		assert(pad,"Ground-floor display pad missing: "..i)
		local slot=plot.Slots["Slot_"..i]
		slot.Size=Vector3.new(pad.Size.X,E.SlotThickness,pad.Size.Z)
		slot.CFrame,slot.Color,slot.Material=pad.CFrame,pad.Color,pad.Material
		slot.Transparency=0 slot.CanCollide=false slot.CanTouch=false
		pad:Destroy()
		padCount+=1
	end
	visual.Parent=plot
	base.Transparency=1
	local spawn=plot.PlotSpawn
	spawn.Transparency=1
	spawn.Position=Vector3.new(base.Position.X-side*(base.Size.X/2-4),top+0.8,base.Position.Z)
	spawn.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(spawn.Position,spawn.Position+Vector3.new(side,0,0))
	local button=plot.LockButton
	button.Position=Vector3.new(base.Position.X-side*(base.Size.X/2-2.5),top+1.1,base.Position.Z+E.PlotLockOffset)
	button.Size=Vector3.new(2,0.6,2)
	local ownerSign=plot.Sign
	ownerSign.Size=E.PlotSignSize
	ownerSign.Position=Vector3.new(base.Position.X-side*(base.Size.X/2-0.2),top+E.PlotSignHeight,base.Position.Z)
	ownerSign.Color=E.StageSignColor ownerSign.Transparency=0 ownerSign.CanCollide=false
	ownerSign.SurfaceGui.Face=side==1 and Enum.NormalId.Left or Enum.NormalId.Right
	ownerSign.SurfaceGui.Label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.95,0.9)
	for _,wall in plot.Barrier:GetChildren() do
		wall.Size=Vector3.new(wall.Size.X,Config.LockBarrierHeight,wall.Size.Z)
		wall.Position=Vector3.new(wall.Position.X,top+Config.LockBarrierHeight/2,wall.Position.Z)
	end
	plot.LockStatus.Position=Vector3.new(base.Position.X,top+Config.LockBarrierHeight+4,base.Position.Z)
	visual:SetAttribute("FittedSize",size)
	return {Plot=n,VisualParts=count-padCount,Slots=padCount,Height=size.Y}
end

function Builder.BuildTrees()
	local root=folder("Trees",environment())
	root:ClearAllChildren()
	for n=1,Config.StageCount,E.WillowStageInterval do
		local stage=workspace.Greybox.Hallway.Stages["Stage_"..n]
		for _,side in {-1,1} do
			local p=Vector3.new(stage.Position.X+side*(stage.Size.X/2+E.TreeOutsideOffset),
				stage.Position.Y+stage.Size.Y/2,stage.Position.Z)
			smallAsset(SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets["Willow Tree"],"WillowTree",p,E.WillowScale,side*math.pi/3).Parent=root
		end
		task.wait()
	end
	local plaza=workspace.Greybox.Plaza.PlazaFloor
	for _,side in {-1,1} do
		local p=Vector3.new(plaza.Position.X+side*(plaza.Size.X/2+E.PlazaTreeOutsideOffset),plaza.Position.Y+plaza.Size.Y/2,plaza.Position.Z)
		smallAsset(SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets["Willow Tree"],"PlazaWillow",p,E.WillowScale,0).Parent=root
	end
	return #root:GetChildren()
end

-- Prepare small, script-free templates; clients only instantiate nearby scenery.
function Builder.PrepareSurroundings()
 local sources = SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets
 local extra = sources.Surroundings
 local RS = game.ReplicatedStorage
 local templates = folder("EnvironmentTemplates", RS)
 templates:ClearAllChildren()
 for _, source in extra:GetChildren() do
  if source.Name:match("^Palm Tree_") or source.Name:match("^Fern_") or source.Name:match("^Swamp Plant_") or source.Name:match("^Bush_") then
   local b = bounds(source)
   local scale = source.Name:match("^Palm") and Config.Landscape.PalmScale or source.Name:match("^Bush") and Config.Landscape.BushScale or Config.Landscape.PlantScale
   fit(source, source.Name, CFrame.new(0,b.Size.Y*scale/2,0), b.Size*scale).Parent = templates
  end
 end
 fit(sources["Realistic grass"], "GroundGrass", CFrame.new(0,Config.Landscape.GrassHeight/2,0), Vector3.new(Config.Landscape.GrassCellSize*1.04,Config.Landscape.GrassHeight,Config.Landscape.GrassCellSize*1.04)).Parent=templates
 return #templates:GetChildren()
end

local function groundBounds()
 return {Position=Config.Landscape.GroundCenter,Size=Config.Landscape.GroundSize,CFrame=CFrame.new(Config.Landscape.GroundCenter)}
end

function Builder.BuildGroundStrip(index)
 local base=groundBounds()
 local depth=Config.Landscape.GroundDepth
 local width=Config.Landscape.BorderSegmentLength
 local count=math.ceil(base.Size.X/width)
 assert(index>=1 and index<=count)
 local left=-base.Size.X/2+(index-1)*width
 local right=math.min(left+width,base.Size.X/2)
 workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(base.CFrame*CFrame.new((left+right)/2,base.Size.Y/2-depth/2,0),Vector3.new(right-left,depth,base.Size.Z),Enum.Material.Grass)
 -- Half-filled top voxels keep the visible surface at baseplate height (full voxels bulge 2 studs above it).
 local surfaceY=base.Position.Y+base.Size.Y/2
 local region=Region3.new(Vector3.new(base.Position.X+left,surfaceY-4,base.Position.Z-base.Size.Z/2),Vector3.new(base.Position.X+right,surfaceY,base.Position.Z+base.Size.Z/2)):ExpandToGrid(4)
 local materials,occupancy=workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region,4)
 for x=1,#occupancy do for z=1,#occupancy[x][1] do occupancy[x][1][z]=0.5 end end
 workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(region,4,materials,occupancy)
 workspace.Terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.Grass,E.GrassColor)
 workspace.Baseplate.Material=Enum.Material.Grass workspace.Baseplate.Color=E.GrassColor workspace.Baseplate.Transparency=1
 return {Strip=index,Count=count}
end

-- Prevent native grass blades from poking through the raised gameplay floors.
function Builder.TrimPlayAreas()
 local function trim(part)
  local half=Vector3.new(part.Size.X/2,0,part.Size.Z/2)
  local groundY=workspace.Baseplate.Position.Y+workspace.Baseplate.Size.Y/2
  local region=Region3.new(Vector3.new(part.Position.X-half.X,groundY-Config.Landscape.GroundDepth,part.Position.Z-half.Z),Vector3.new(part.Position.X+half.X,groundY,part.Position.Z+half.Z)):ExpandToGrid(4)
  workspace.Terrain:ReplaceMaterial(region,4,Enum.Material.Grass,Enum.Material.LeafyGrass)
 end
 for _,stage in workspace.Greybox.Hallway.Stages:GetChildren() do if stage:IsA("BasePart") then trim(stage) end end
 for _,plot in workspace.Greybox.Plots:GetChildren() do if plot:FindFirstChild("Base") then trim(plot.Base) end end
 trim(workspace.Greybox.Plaza.PlazaFloor)
 local apron=workspace.Greybox.Hallway:FindFirstChild("EntranceApron")
 if apron then trim(apron) end
 workspace.Greybox.Plaza.PlazaFloor.Material=Enum.Material.Grass
 workspace.Greybox.Plaza.PlazaFloor.Color=E.GrassColor
end

function Builder.BuildPerimeter(side)
 local L=Config.Landscape
 local base=groundBounds()
 local root=folder("Perimeter",environment())
 local name="Side_"..side
 local old=root:FindFirstChild(name) if old then old:Destroy() end
 local group=Instance.new("Model") group.Name=name group.Parent=root
 local alongX=side<=2
 local length=alongX and base.Size.X or base.Size.Z
 local direction=side%2==1 and -1 or 1
 local offset=alongX and Vector3.new(0,base.Size.Y/2+L.BorderHeight/2,direction*(base.Size.Z/2-L.BorderDepth/2)) or Vector3.new(direction*(base.Size.X/2-L.BorderDepth/2),base.Size.Y/2+L.BorderHeight/2,0)
 local frame=base.CFrame*CFrame.new(offset)*CFrame.Angles(0,alongX and math.pi/2 or 0,0)
 local collisionCount=math.ceil(length/2048)
 for i=1,collisionCount do
  local collider=Instance.new("Part") collider.Name=i==1 and "BorderCollision" or "BorderCollision_"..i
  collider.Size=Vector3.new(L.BorderDepth,L.BorderHeight,length/collisionCount)
  collider.CFrame=frame*CFrame.new(0,0,-length/2+(i-0.5)*length/collisionCount)
  collider.Anchored=true collider.Transparency=1 collider.CastShadow=false collider.Parent=group
 end
 local source=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets.GrassToplingsH1:GetChildren()[1]:GetChildren()[1]
 local count=math.ceil(length/L.BorderSegmentLength)
 for i=1,count do
  local segment=fit(source,"GrassBorder_"..i,frame*CFrame.new(0,0,-length/2+(i-0.5)*length/count),Vector3.new(L.BorderDepth,L.BorderHeight,length/count+0.2))
  segment.Parent=group task.wait()
 end
 return count
end

-- Seal asset openings from the outside; preserve the existing border transforms.
function Builder.BuildPerimeterBacking()
 local L=Config.Landscape
 local source
 for _,model in workspace:GetChildren() do
  if model.Name=="MainWall" then
   for _,part in model:GetDescendants() do
    if part:IsA("Part") and part.Material==Enum.Material.Slate then
     if not source or part.Size.X*part.Size.Y*part.Size.Z>source.Size.X*source.Size.Y*source.Size.Z then source=part end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 assert(source,"MainWall slate reference is missing")
 local root=folder("Perimeter",environment())
 local count=0
 for side=1,4 do
  local group=root["Side_"..side]
  local old=group:FindFirstChild("SolidBacking") if old then old:Destroy() end
  local backing=Instance.new("Folder") backing.Name="SolidBacking"
  for _,collider in group:GetChildren() do if collider:IsA("BasePart") and collider.Name:match("^BorderCollision") then
  local outward=side%2==1 and -1 or 1
  local worldOutward=side<=2 and Vector3.new(0,0,outward) or Vector3.new(outward,0,0)
  local depthOffset=collider.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(worldOutward)*(collider.Size.X+L.BorderBackingDepth)/2
  local length=collider.Size.Z+L.BorderCornerOverlap*2
  local segments=math.ceil(length/L.BorderBackingSegmentLength)
  for i=1,segments do
   local part=source:Clone() part:ClearAllChildren()
   for _,tag in CS:GetTags(part) do CS:RemoveTag(part,tag) end
   part.Name="WallBacking_"..i
   part.Size=Vector3.new(L.BorderBackingDepth,collider.Size.Y+L.BorderBackingGroundOverlap,length/segments+0.1)
   part.CFrame=collider.CFrame*CFrame.new(depthOffset,-L.BorderBackingGroundOverlap/2,-length/2+(i-0.5)*length/segments)
   part.Anchored=true part.CanCollide=true part.CanTouch=false part.CanQuery=true part.CastShadow=false part.Transparency=0
   part.Parent=backing count+=1
  end
  end end
  backing.Parent=group task.wait()
 end
 return count
end

function Builder.BuildTorches()
 local L=Config.Landscape
 local root=folder("Torches",environment()) root:ClearAllChildren()
 local source=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets.Surroundings.WallTorch_1
 local b=bounds(source)
 local function mount(position,angle,name)
  local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name=name
  local copy=source:Clone() copy.Parent=model
  local frame=CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(0,angle,0)
  local firstLight
  for _,v in model:GetDescendants() do
   if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then v:Destroy()
   elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
    v.Size*=L.TorchScale v.CFrame=frame*CFrame.new((v.Position-b.Center)*L.TorchScale)*v.CFrame.Rotation
    v.Anchored=true v.CanCollide=false v.CanTouch=false v.CanQuery=false v.CastShadow=false
   elseif v:IsA("Light") then
    if firstLight then v:Destroy() else firstLight=v v.Enabled=false v.Shadows=false v.Range=L.TorchLightRange v.Brightness=L.TorchLightBrightness end
   elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
    v.Enabled=false v.Rate=v.Name=="Fire" and L.TorchFireRate or v.Name=="Glow" and L.TorchGlowRate or L.TorchSmokeRate
   end
  end
  model.WorldPivot=frame model:SetAttribute("TorchFixture",true) model.Parent=root
 end
 for _,plot in workspace.Greybox.Plots:GetChildren() do
  local base=plot:FindFirstChild("Base")
  if base then
   for floor=0,2 do for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
    local p=base.Position+Vector3.new(x*(base.Size.X/2-L.TorchMountInset),base.Size.Y/2+L.TorchMountHeight+floor*L.TorchFloorSpacing,z*(base.Size.Z/2-L.TorchMountInset))
    mount(p,x==1 and math.pi or 0,plot.Name.."_Torch")
   end end end
  end
  task.wait()
 end
 for n=1,Config.StageCount do
  local stage=workspace.Greybox.Hallway.Stages["Stage_"..n]
  for _,side in {-1,1} do for i=1,L.TorchStagesPerSide do
   local p=stage.Position+Vector3.new(side*(stage.Size.X/2-0.9),stage.Size.Y/2+L.TorchMountHeight,stage.Size.Z*((i-0.5)/L.TorchStagesPerSide-0.5))
   mount(p,side==1 and 0 or math.pi,"Stage_"..n.."_Torch")
  end end
  task.wait()
 end
 return #root:GetChildren()
end

-- Ground-floor trim only; both side gates stay open for the existing plot controls.
function Builder.BuildFences()
 local root=folder("PlotFences",environment())
 root:ClearAllChildren()
 local source=SS.EnvironmentSourceAssets.Fence
 local ref=bounds(source)
 local count=0
 for _,plot in workspace.Greybox.Plots:GetChildren() do
  local base=plot.Base
  local x=base.Size.X/2+E.FenceOutsideOffset
  local z=base.Size.Z/2+E.FenceOutsideOffset
  local y=base.Position.Y+base.Size.Y/2+E.FenceHeight/2
  local group=Instance.new("Folder") group.Name=plot.Name group.Parent=root

GuardService:
--[[
	GuardService: simple NPC guards. Each stage has Config.GuardCountPerStage[stage] guards that
	patrol random points inside their own stage zone and chase the nearest player in range.
	A guard that touches a player knocks them back (the hit client applies the impulse) and makes
	them drop their card. No pathfinding: guards move in a straight line, clamped to their zone.
	Guards only update while a player is within Config.GuardActivationDistance of their stage;
	otherwise they stand still and the Heartbeat connection is disconnected entirely.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local GuardService = {}

local CardService -- injected in Init
local guardsFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("Greybox"):WaitForChild("Guards")
local rng = Random.new()
local zones = {}    -- [stage] = floor part
local guards = {}   -- [stage] = { { model, stage, waypoint, stunUntil }, ... }
local active = {}   -- [stage] = true while a player is near
local hitUntil = {} -- [Player] = os.clock() until which the player is immune
local heartbeat: RBXScriptConnection?

local function pointIn(zone: Part): Vector3
	local reach = zone.Size / 2 - Vector3.one * Config.GuardZoneMargin
	return Vector3.new(
		zone.Position.X + rng:NextNumber(-reach.X, reach.X),
		Config.GroundY + Config.GuardSize.Y / 2,
		zone.Position.Z + rng:NextNumber(-reach.Z, reach.Z)
	)
end

local function clampToZone(position: Vector3, zone: Part): Vector3
	local reach = zone.Size / 2 - Vector3.one * Config.GuardZoneMargin
	return Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(position.X, zone.Position.X - reach.X, zone.Position.X + reach.X),
		position.Y,
		math.clamp(position.Z, zone.Position.Z - reach.Z, zone.Position.Z + reach.Z)
	)
end

local function createGuard(stage: number)
	local zone = zones[stage]
	local position = pointIn(zone)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Guard_Stage" .. stage

	local function block(name: string, size: Vector3, color: Color3, center: Vector3)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.Position = center
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = block("Body", Config.GuardSize, Config.GuardColor, position)
	block("Head", Vector3.one * Config.GuardHeadSize, Config.GuardColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3),
		position + Vector3.new(0, (Config.GuardSize.Y + Config.GuardHeadSize) / 2, 0))

	CollectionService:AddTag(model, "Guard")
	model.Parent = guardsFolder
	table.insert(guards[stage], { model = model, stage = stage, waypoint = pointIn(zone), stunUntil = 0 })
end

local function livingTargets(): { { player: Player, root: BasePart } }
	local targets = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			table.insert(targets, { player = player, root = root })
		end
	end
	return targets
end

local function hit(guard, target, now: number)
	hitUntil[target.player] = now + Config.GuardHitCooldownSeconds
	guard.stunUntil = now + Config.GuardStunSeconds
	local away = target.root.Position - guard.model.PrimaryPart.Position
	local flat = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
	local direction = flat.Magnitude > 0 and flat.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	Remotes.Knockback:FireClient(target.player, direction * Config.GuardKnockbackSpeed + Vector3.new(0, Config.GuardKnockbackUp, 0))
	CardService.DropCarried(target.player)
end

local function updateGuard(guard, targets, dt: number, now: number)
	if now < guard.stunUntil then return end
	local stage, zone = guard.stage, zones[guard.stage]
	local position = guard.model.PrimaryPart.Position

	local nearest, nearestDistance
	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		local offset = target.root.Position - position
		if offset.Magnitude <= Config.GuardHitRadius and (hitUntil[target.player] or 0) <= now then
			hit(guard, target, now)
			return
		end
		local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z).Magnitude
		if flat <= Config.GuardChaseRange[stage] and (not nearestDistance or flat < nearestDistance) then
			nearest, nearestDistance = target, flat
		end
	end

	local destination, speed
	if nearest then
		destination, speed = nearest.root.Position, Config.GuardChaseSpeed[stage]
	else
		if Vector3.new(guard.waypoint.X - position.X, 0, guard.waypoint.Z - position.Z).Magnitude <= Config.GuardWaypointReach then
			guard.waypoint = pointIn(zone)
		end
		destination, speed = guard.waypoint, Config.GuardChaseSpeed[stage] * Config.GuardPatrolSpeedFactor
	end

	local delta = Vector3.new(destination.X - position.X, 0, destination.Z - position.Z)
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local nextPosition = clampToZone(position + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, delta.Magnitude), zone)
	guard.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, nextPosition + delta.Unit))
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local targets = livingTargets()
	for stage in pairs(active) do
		for _, guard in ipairs(guards[stage]) do
			updateGuard(guard, targets, dt, now)
		end
	end
end

local function distanceToZone(position: Vector3, zone: Part): number
	local offset = position - zone.Position
	local dx = math.max(math.abs(offset.X) - zone.Size.X / 2, 0)
	local dz = math.max(math.abs(offset.Z) - zone.Size.Z / 2, 0)
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

--- Work out which stages have a player nearby; only those are simulated.
local function refreshActive()
	table.clear(active)
	for _, target in ipairs(livingTargets()) do
		for stage, zone in pairs(zones) do
			if distanceToZone(target.root.Position, zone) <= Config.GuardActivationDistance then
				active[stage] = true
			end
		end
	end
	local anyActive = next(active) ~= nil
	if anyActive and not heartbeat then
		heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
	elseif not anyActive and heartbeat then
		heartbeat:Disconnect()
		heartbeat = nil
	end
end

function GuardService.Init(cardService)
	CardService = cardService
	for _, floor in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StageZone")) do
		zones[floor:GetAttribute("Stage")] = floor
	end
	for stage in pairs(zones) do
		guards[stage] = {}
		for _ = 1, Config.GuardCountPerStage[stage] do
			createGuard(stage)
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) hitUntil[player] = nil end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			refreshActive()
			task.wait(Config.GuardActivationCheckSeconds)
		end
	end)
end

return GuardService

local function scheduleDespawn(card: Part, seconds: number)
	if seconds <= 0 then return end
	local token = (card:GetAttribute("DropToken") or 0) + 1
	card:SetAttribute("DropToken", token)
	task.delay(seconds, function()
		if card.Parent and card:GetAttribute("State") == "World" and card:GetAttribute("DropToken") == token then
			card:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function setCarryAttributes(player: Player, card: Part?)
	player:SetAttribute("CarriedCard", card and card:GetAttribute("CardName"))
	player:SetAttribute("CarriedTier", card and card:GetAttribute("Tier"))
end

function CardService.GetCarried(player: Player): Part?
	return carried[player]
end

--- Attach a card above the player's head. Returns true on success.
function CardService.Carry(player: Player, card: Part): boolean
	local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(player)
	if carried[player] or not head or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

	carried[player] = card
	local root = getRoot(player)
	lastPos[player] = root and root.Position or head.Position
	CardService.SetState(card, "Carried")
	card.Anchored = false
	card.Massless = true
	card.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(Config.CarryOffset)
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = head
	weld.Part1 = card
	weld.Parent = card

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Tiers[card:GetAttribute("Tier")].WalkSpeed
	setCarryAttributes(player, card)
	return true
end

--- Detach the carried card (no drop). Returns the card, or nil. Caller decides what happens to it.
function CardService.Release(player: Player): Part?
	local card = carried[player]
	if not card then return nil end
	carried[player] = nil
	lastPos[player] = nil
	card.CarryWeld:Destroy()
	card.Anchored = true
	card.Massless = false
	local humanoid = getHumanoid(player)
	if humanoid then humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.BaseWalkSpeed end
	setCarryAttributes(player, nil)
	return card
end

local function dropOnGround(card: Part, position: Vector3, lifetime: number)
	card.CFrame = CFrame.new(position.X, Config.GroundY + card.Size.Y / 2 + Config.CardRestHeight, position.Z)
	card.Parent = cardsFolder
	CardService.SetState(card, "World")
	scheduleDespawn(card, lifetime)
end

local function tryPickup(player: Player, card: Part)
	local root = getRoot(player)
	if not root or not card.Parent or card:GetAttribute("State") ~= "World" then return end
	if (root.Position - card.Position).Magnitude > Config.PickupMaxDistance then return end
	CardService.Carry(player, card)
end

local function createCard(name: string, tier: string): Part
	local info = Config.Tiers[tier]
	local card = Instance.new("Part")
	card.Name = "Card_" .. name
	card.Size = Config.CardSize
	card.Color = info.Color
	card.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	card.Anchored = true
	card.CanCollide = false
	card.CanTouch = false
	card:SetAttribute("CardName", name)
	card:SetAttribute("Tier", tier)
	card:SetAttribute("CashPerSecond", info.CashPerSecond)
	CollectionService:AddTag(card, "Card")
	makeLabel(card, name, tier)

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PickupPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Pick up"
	prompt.ObjectText = name .. " (" .. tier .. ")"
	prompt.HoldDuration = Config.PickupHoldSeconds
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = Config.PickupPromptDistance
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = card
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryPickup(player, card) end)
	return card
end

--- Called when a cube breaks: drop a random card of `tier` on the floor below `position`.
function CardService.DropFromCube(tier: string, position: Vector3)
	dropOnGround(createCard(Config.PickCardName(tier), tier), position, Config.CubeDropLifetime)
end

-- Death / leave handling -------------------------------------------------

--- Drop whatever `player` carries: back to its owner if stolen, otherwise onto the floor.
function CardService.DropCarried(player: Player, char: Model?)
	char = char or player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local position = root and root.Position or lastPos[player] or Config.FallbackDropPosition
	local card = CardService.Release(player)
	if not card or returnStolen(card) then return end
	dropOnGround(card, position, Config.DroppedCardLifetime)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player: Player, char: Model)
	local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.BaseWalkSpeed
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function() CardService.DropCarried(player, char) end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) onCharacterAdded(player, char) end)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(char) CardService.DropCarried(player, char) end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacterAdded, player, player.Character)
	end
end

function CardService.Init(returnStolenFn)
	returnStolen = returnStolenFn
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		onPlayerAdded(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		CardService.DropCarried(player)
		lastPos[player] = nil
	end)

	-- Track last known position of carriers (fallback if the character is already gone)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.CarryTrackSeconds)
			for player in pairs(carried) do
				local root = getRoot(player)
				if root then lastPos[player] = root.Position end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CardService
PromptFilter:
--[[
	PromptFilter: hides the slot / lock prompts that do not apply to the local player.
	Purely cosmetic - the server re-checks every rule. Event-driven: prompts are only
	recomputed when a relevant attribute changes (plot OwnerUserId / LockState,
	slot CardName, or the player's CarriedCard). The server never touches these prompts' Enabled.
	  Owner:     SlotPrompt for (empty slot while carrying) or (filled slot with free hands); LockPrompt when Ready.
	  Non-owner: StealPrompt on a filled slot of an owned, unlocked plot, with free hands.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PromptFilter = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function refreshSlot(slot: BasePart)
	local plot = slot:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") :: Model
	local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	local isOwner = ownerId == player.UserId
	local filled = slot:GetAttribute("CardName") ~= nil
	local carrying = player:GetAttribute("CarriedCard") ~= nil
	local reserved = slot:GetAttribute("Reserved") == true
	slot.SlotPrompt.Enabled = isOwner and not reserved and filled ~= carrying
	slot.StealPrompt.Enabled = ownerId ~= 0 and not isOwner and filled and not carrying and not reserved
		and plot:GetAttribute("LockState") ~= "Locked"
end

local function refreshPlot(plot: Model)
	for _, slot in ipairs(plot.Slots:GetChildren()) do
		refreshSlot(slot)
	end
	plot.LockButton.LockPrompt.Enabled = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId
		and plot:GetAttribute("LockState") == "Ready"
end

function PromptFilter.Init()
	local plots = CollectionService:GetTagged("Plot")
	for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
		for _, attribute in ipairs({ "OwnerUserId", "LockState" }) do
			plot:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function() refreshPlot(plot) end)
		end
		for _, slot in ipairs(plot.Slots:GetChildren()) do
			for _, attribute in ipairs({ "CardName", "Reserved" }) do
				slot:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function() refreshSlot(slot) end)
			end
		end
		refreshPlot(plot)
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CarriedCard"):Connect(function()
		for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do refreshPlot(plot) end
	end)
end

return PromptFilter
SlotService:
--[[
	SlotService: placing, picking up and stealing cards on plot slots (parts tagged "Slot").
	- Owner + empty slot + carrying      -> place (SlotPrompt).
	- Owner + filled slot + hands free   -> pick back up (SlotPrompt).
	- Non-owner + filled slot + hands free + plot not locked -> steal (StealPrompt, hold).
	  The thief carries the card; placing it in their own slot transfers ownership.
	- A stolen card that gets dropped goes back to its owner (ReturnStolen).
	The client hides prompts that do not apply (PromptFilter), but every rule is enforced here.
	Slot attribute CardName mirrors the slot content for the client.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local LineOfSight = require(script.Parent.LineOfSight)

local SlotService = {}

local PlotService, CardService, LockService -- injected in Init
local slotCards = {} -- [slotPart] = card part
local homeSlot = {} -- [stolen card] = reserved original slot
local reserved = {} -- [slot] = stolen card

local function refreshSlot(slot: BasePart, card: Part?)
	local name = card and card:GetAttribute("CardName")
	local beingStolen = reserved[slot] ~= nil
	slot:SetAttribute("Reserved", beingStolen)
	slot.ReservationGui.Enabled = beingStolen
	slot:SetAttribute("CardName", name)
	slot.SlotPrompt.ActionText = card and "Pick up" or "Place card"
	slot.SlotPrompt.ObjectText = beingStolen and "BEING STOLEN" or name or "Slot " .. slot:GetAttribute("SlotIndex")
	slot.StealPrompt.ObjectText = name or "Slot " .. slot:GetAttribute("SlotIndex")
end

local function clearStolen(card: Part)
	local home = homeSlot[card]
	homeSlot[card] = nil
	card:SetAttribute("OriginalOwnerUserId", nil)
	if home and reserved[home] == card then
		reserved[home] = nil
		refreshSlot(home, slotCards[home])
	end
end

local function occupy(slot: BasePart, card: Part)
	card.CFrame = slot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (slot.Size.Y + card.Size.Y) / 2 + 0.1, 0)
	CardService.SetState(card, "Placed")
	slotCards[slot] = card
	clearStolen(card)
	refreshSlot(slot, card)
end

local function isAliveAndNear(player: Player, slot: BasePart): boolean
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
		and (root.Position - slot.Position).Magnitude <= Config.InteractMaxDistance
end

local function onOwnerTriggered(player: Player, slot: BasePart)
	local plot = PlotService.GetPlotOfInstance(slot)
	if not plot or PlotService.GetOwner(plot) ~= player or reserved[slot] or not isAliveAndNear(player, slot) then return end

	local placed = slotCards[slot]
	if placed then
		if CardService.Carry(player, placed) then
			slotCards[slot] = nil
			refreshSlot(slot, nil)
		end
		return
	end

	local card = CardService.Release(player)
	if card then occupy(slot, card) end
end

local function onStealTriggered(thief: Player, slot: BasePart)
	local plot = PlotService.GetPlotOfInstance(slot)
	local owner = plot and PlotService.GetOwner(plot)
	local card = slotCards[slot]
	if not owner or owner == thief or not card or LockService.IsLocked(plot) or not isAliveAndNear(thief, slot) then return end
	if not LineOfSight.IsClear(thief.Character, slot, slot.Position) then return end
	if not CardService.Carry(thief, card) then return end

	slotCards[slot] = nil
	homeSlot[card] = slot
	reserved[slot] = card
	card:SetAttribute("OriginalOwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	refreshSlot(slot, nil)
	Remotes.Announcement:FireClient(owner, Config.StealAlert:format(thief.DisplayName, card:GetAttribute("CardName")))
end

--- Recover only to the reserved slot while the original owner still owns the plot.
function SlotService.ReturnStolen(card: Part): boolean
	local home = homeSlot[card]
	local userId = card:GetAttribute("OriginalOwnerUserId")
	local owner = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local plot = home and PlotService.GetPlotOfInstance(home)
	local canReturn = owner and plot and PlotService.GetOwner(plot) == owner
		and reserved[home] == card and not slotCards[home]
	clearStolen(card)
	if not canReturn then return false end
	occupy(home, card)
	return true
end

--- Total cash/sec of all cards placed on a plot.
function SlotService.GetPlotIncome(plot: Model): number
	local total = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(plot.Slots:GetChildren()) do
		local card = slotCards[slot]
		if card then total += card:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond") end
	end
	return total
end

--- Remove all placed cards from a plot (used when the owner leaves).
local function clearPlot(plot: Model)
	for _, slot in ipairs(plot.Slots:GetChildren()) do
		if reserved[slot] then clearStolen(reserved[slot]) end
		local card = slotCards[slot]
		if card then
			slotCards[slot] = nil
			card:Destroy()
			refreshSlot(slot, nil)
		end
	end
end

function SlotService.Init(plotService, cardService, lockService)
	PlotService = plotService
	CardService = cardService
	LockService = lockService

	for _, slot in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Slot")) do
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "ReservationGui"
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Config.ReservationLabelSize.X, Config.ReservationLabelSize.Y)
		gui.StudsOffset = Config.ReservationLabelOffset
		gui.MaxDistance = Config.ReservationLabelMaxDistance
		gui.Enabled = false
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = "BEING STOLEN"
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextColor3 = Config.Tiers.GOAT.Color
		label.Parent = gui
		gui.Parent = slot
		refreshSlot(slot, slotCards[slot])
		slot.StealPrompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true
		slot.SlotPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) onOwnerTriggered(player, slot) end)
		slot.StealPrompt.HoldDuration = Config.StealHoldSeconds
		slot.StealPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) onStealTriggered(player, slot) end)
	end
	PlotService.PlotFreed.Event:Connect(clearPlot)
end

return SlotService
PlotService:
--[[
	PlotService: assigns one plot (Workspace/Greybox/Plots/Plot_n) per player.
	- Sets the owner's name on the sign and OwnerUserId attribute on the plot.
	- Sets player.RespawnLocation to the plot's PlotSpawn.
	- Fires PlotFreed(plot, player) BEFORE the plot is released so other services can clean up.
	Future hook: stealing/guards read GetOwner(plot) from here.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlotService = {}

PlotService.PlotAssigned = Instance.new("BindableEvent") -- (plot, player)
PlotService.PlotFreed = Instance.new("BindableEvent")    -- (plot, player)

local plots = {}       -- sorted list of plot Models
local ownerOfPlot = {} -- [plot] = Player
local plotOfPlayer = {} -- [Player] = plot

local function setSign(plot, text)
	local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("Sign")
	local label = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Label")
	if label then
		label.Text = text
	end
end

function PlotService.GetPlot(player: Player): Model?
	return plotOfPlayer[player]
end

function PlotService.GetOwner(plot: Model): Player?
	return ownerOfPlot[plot]
end

function PlotService.GetPlotOfInstance(inst: Instance): Model?
	local cur = inst
	while cur do
		if CollectionService:HasTag(cur, "Plot") then
			return cur :: Model
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function assign(player: Player)
	if plotOfPlayer[player] then return end
	for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
		if not ownerOfPlot[plot] then
			ownerOfPlot[plot] = player
			plotOfPlayer[player] = plot
			plot:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
			setSign(plot, player.DisplayName .. "'s Base")

			local spawn = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSpawn")
			if spawn then
				player.RespawnLocation = spawn
				-- If character already exists (script started late), move it
				local char = player.Character
				if char and char.PrimaryPart then
					char:PivotTo(spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
				end
			end
			PlotService.PlotAssigned:Fire(plot, player)
			return
		end
	end
	warn(("[PlotService] No free plot for %s"):format(player.Name))
end

local function release(player: Player)
	local plot = plotOfPlayer[player]
	if not plot then return end
	PlotService.PlotFreed:Fire(plot, player) -- listeners clear placed cards
	ownerOfPlot[plot] = nil
	plotOfPlayer[player] = nil
	plot:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)
	setSign(plot, "Free Plot")
end

function PlotService.Init()
	for _, plot in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Plot")) do
		table.insert(plots, plot)
	end
	table.sort(plots, function(a, b)
		return (a:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") or 0) < (b:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") or 0)
	end)
	if #plots == 0 then
		warn("[PlotService] No plots tagged 'Plot' found in Workspace/Greybox")
	end
	for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
		plot:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)
		setSign(plot, "Free Plot")
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assign)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(release)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		assign(p)
	end
end

return PlotService
